children.name: page-products-para-0
children.content: PAMA has a long experience in machine tools that starts in the field of boring and milling and has been completed over the years with turning.

children.name: page-products-para-1
children.content: The basis of PAMA’s success is its range of high-value technological solutions consisting of a wide selection of machine tools that are characterised by quality, precision and reliability.

children.name: page-products-para-2
children.content: Horizontal milling machines are available with a central headstock and are designed to guarantee high dynamics at the ultimate level of reliability and precision.

children.name: page-products-para-3
children.content: PAMA Speedmill milling machines are able to combine high damping, high dynamics, and high spindle speed with optimal working precision.
